summary: Tuscaloosa County steel lookout that both registers record as out of use by April 2016 and removed by October 2016, so it is not standing.

facts.status_note: Removed by October 2016; the landowner wanted it taken down as of April 2016

events.note: Both registers say the tower was removed by October 2016

corrections.why: Both registers record the tower as no longer in use by April 2016 and removed by October 2016

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief lists the tower as standing, but both registers describe its removal by October 2016. The removal notes are more specific and agree with each other, so the status is treated as removed.

notes_for_editor: Removal is stated by both registers, but they are sister sites run by the same network, so they are not fully independent. No build year exists in any source read, so no built event is recorded. The 2016 'removed' event and the status correction are the main changes to the brief. Two searches found no other account of the tower or its removal. No photo is recorded: the FFLOS page credits a 2016 photo to Andrew Zerbe, but no image URL was in the cached page text.
